args.content:
Based on the existing Hawaii vacation planning document, the packing list includes:

Clothing:
- 3-4 tops (t-shirts, blouses)
- 2-3 bottoms (shorts, pants)
- 1-2 light jackets or sweaters
- 1-2 swimsuits
- 2-3 pairs of comfortable walking shoes
- 1-2 pairs of sandals or flip flops
- Socks and undergarments

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Soap
- Razor and shaving cream
- Makeup and makeup remover
- Hairbrush or comb
- Contact lenses and solution
- Prescription medication

Electronics:
- Smartphone and charger
- Laptop and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable charger
- Headphones
- Travel adapter

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Sunscreen
- Sunglasses
- Insect repellent
- Snorkeling gear (if applicable)
- Beach bag or backpack
- Collapsible umbrella
- Travel documents (passport, ID)
- Cash and credit cards
- Travel insurance information

Additional Hawaii-specific items:
- Lightweight rain jacket
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Water shoes
- Beach reading material
- Snorkeling or diving certification cards
- Hawaiian-style clothing (optional)

This list is based on the existing Hawaii vacation planning document and can be tailored to individual needs and activities.
